Intrauterine means "inside the uterus." Information A baby grows inside the mother's womb or uterus. This is called an intrauterine pregnancy. An intrauterine device (IUD) is an object placed in the uterus to prevent conception and pregnancy. Images Female reproductive anatomy Uterus References Nunziato JD, Valea FA.
